_opened: OPENED 2026-08-21 at the founder's word ('good to post the ec2 quest too'). beneficiary stays null until he names where the dollars route — deriveEpochClose refuses a close until then, so the stake lane is live while the money lane still waits on his word.
title: Keep the lights on — the town box
source: The town runs on a real machine with a real monthly bill (~$150/mo). This pot is how the town keeps its own lights on: stake stamps on it to say the box matters to you; real dollars paid against it are witnessed as receipts; at each month's close, the share of every stake that the month's dollars funded burns and splits between the stakers themselves and the payers per the keeping law (ECONOMY-DIALS.json law_side.keeping). Fund the whole $150 and every stake converts; fund half and half of each stake converts, the rest comes home. The stakers' half is minted back to them, source-tagged for keeping: a permanent record of what they backed, with no liquid coin — the coin was already paid when the stake burned.
_beneficiary: where the DOLLARS route — named by Keemin at opening; deriveEpochClose refuses a close on a pot with no beneficiary, and the treasury can never be one (the town never receives from its own seam). The beneficiary receives no stamps from the close: the sigma leg goes back to the stakers. NAMED 2026-08-23 at the founder's word ('two pot words are fine as suggested'): keeminlee — the hand that actually pays the box's bill; witnessed dollars route to the payer of the AWS invoice. The beneficiary receives no stamps from the close; the sigma leg goes back to the stakers, as ever.
_target: target_usd_per_epoch is the posted need, and it is the ONLY thing dollars are priced against — the funded fraction is min(1, non-treasury dollars / target). A pot with no target cannot close.
_uncapped: D5 (Keemin, 2026-08-21): 'intake refuses dollars past a pot's posted target, mechanically (recording tool / door bounce), except pots explicitly marked uncapped.' This pot posts a need, so it is capped: once the epoch's witnessed dollars reach the target, intake bounces and names the remaining headroom. Set true only for a standing box with no target (the donation-box shape), where whatever arrives is welcome.
_received: display only, refreshed by tools/epoch-close.mjs --receipt — the ledger's pot-receipt rows are authoritative
_grammar: stakes ride the sealed ledger as `<handle> → stake:pot/keeping-ec2 · n · via: ...` (the existing stake verb, pot as subject); witnessed dollars land as pot-receipt rows; the manual founder-run close (tools/epoch-close.mjs --close) appends the pot-return / keeping-burn / `minted · for: keeping:<pot>` / holo / patron-deed block, which stamp-verify replays exactly
